selection.rule: large when the live safe rectangle is at least large_min_safe_width by large_min_safe_height points; otherwise compact. A regular by regular size class sets bottom_band and uses the lower keyboard inset instead of the raised one. Insets come from the window safe area.

size_classes.compact: Lower grip for a short or narrow safe rectangle, including the cover screen.
size_classes.large: Raised side grip when the safe rectangle is tablet-like and bottom_band is not set. Width of at least 1000 points also applies the existing wide scale.
size_classes.bottom_band: Regular horizontal and vertical size classes. The whole grip sits on the bottom of the safe rectangle, in the keyboard band, and stays off active fold and camera regions.

saved_layout_keys.legacy_read: HaloPad.phone.v3 or HaloPad.tablet.v3 is read only when the size class still matches that idiom. Writes and resets use v4.
